name: ReportPortal
description: AI-assisted test automation reporting and analytics platform for continuous testing.

envVars.description: Database password used to connect to Postgres

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      RP_DB_HOST: "{{serviceName}}-postgres"
      RP_DB_NAME: reportportal
      RP_DB_USER: rpuser
      RP_DB_PASSWORD: {{env.RP_DB_PASSWORD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/data:/data
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: rpuser
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.RP_DB_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: reportportal
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
  {{serviceName}}-ui:
    image: reportportal/service-ui:latest
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-ui
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      RP_API_URL: "http://{{serviceName}}:8080"
  {{serviceName}}-index:
    image: reportportal/service-index:latest
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-index
    restart: unless-stopped
